title: War Drama ‘Peluru Senja: The Ghost & the Gun’ Locks Malaysia Theatrical Date, Drops Trailer (EXCLUSIVE)
content:
ByNaman Ramachandran

The first trailer for “Peluru Senja: The Ghost & the Gun” has arrived alongside confirmation of a nationwide Malaysian theatrical release on Aug. 28, timed to the country’s Independence Day weekend.

Local distributor MSK Cinemas will handle the rollout.

The BahasaMalaysia-language feature is the third film from Singapore-based Indian director Anshul Tiwari, whose previous credits include “Before Life After Death” and “Bayaar.” The screenplay was written by Abhi Kumar. Producers are Debasmita Dasgupta, Tim Willrich, Bo H. Holmgreen and Mikail Chowdhury, with Jessie White of Misfit Studios serving as executive producer alongside Mohsen Ashraf of Friendly Felix Studios, Tanveer Ali, Amreen Bashir of Amra Bangladeshi and Tahmid Khan of Auras.

Set in 1948 Malaya in the volatile years that followed the end of World War II, the film traces a Malay soldier and a British soldier who are left behind after the British military withdraws. Together they must reckon with their wartime histories while protecting a village under threat from armed rebels.

Award-winning Malaysian actor Fabian Loo – known for “Rain Town” and “One Cent Thief” – leads the cast alongside Hazman Al-Idrus. They are joined by celebrated Indonesian actor Asmara Abigail (“Stone Turtle,” “Impetigore”) and U.S. actor Brett Tutor (“Monsters of Man”).

Tiwari said: “We have many World War II films but rarely are they centred on people from this region nor do we see the impact of the British withdrawal and the ensuing mess. Abhi Kumar’s screenplay offered the perfect opportunity to explore a theme that gripped me: the psychological trauma carried by war survivors.”

Production drew on talent and crew from six countries. Dasgupta, whose company is FilmsPositive, said the shoot reflected the collaborative ambition at the project’s core. “We proudly united talent and crew from Malaysia, Indonesia, Singapore, India, Bangladesh and the U.K. to bring it to life,” she said.

The film carries a further distinction as one of the first war features shot entirely in Bali. “Filming in Bali allowed us to craft a visually stunning backdrop with natural locations and we built fourteen sets to replicate 1940’s Malaysia,” said Bo H. Holmgreen, producer and CEO of Viking Sunset Studios. “Accompanying this fabulous war movie back to its cultural and historical origins is very exciting.”

“We believe ‘Peluru Senja’ has the potential to connect with audiences through its unique identity and compelling narrative. We are committed to delivering a strong theatrical release,” said Saradha Sivalingam of MSK Cinemas, who added the company was drawn by the film’s “powerful storytelling, authentic Malaysian setting and strong emotional core, combined with high production values that deserve to be experienced on the big screen.”

White offered a similar note. “This film has always been about telling a deeply human story against the backdrop of an important moment in Malaysian history, and we can’t wait to share it on the big screen,” she said.

The production made use of Malaysia’s post-production infrastructure and incorporated creative voices from across South and Southeast Asia.

“Peluru Senja: The Ghost & the Gun” opens in Malaysian cinemas nationwide on Aug. 28.

title_zh: 戰爭劇情片《彈幕夕陽：鬼魂與槍(Peluru Senja: The Ghost & the Gun)》確定馬來西亞上映日期，並釋出預告片（獨家）。
content_zh:
由納曼·拉馬昌德蘭(Naman Ramachandran)報導

《夕陽子彈：鬼魂與槍》(Peluru Senja: The Ghost & the Gun)的首支預告片已經發布，並確認將於8月28日全國上映，恰逢馬來西亞獨立日的週末。

當地發行商MSK Cinemas將負責推廣。

這部以馬來語為主的電影是新加坡籍印度導演安舒爾·提瓦里(Anshul Tiwari)的第三部作品，他之前的作品包括《死後的生活之前》(Before Life After Death)和《巴雅爾》(Bayaar)。劇本由阿比·庫馬爾(Abhi Kumar)撰寫。製片人包括德巴斯米塔·達斯古普塔(Debasmita Dasgupta)、蒂姆·威爾里奇(Tim Willrich)、博·霍姆格林(Bo H. Holmgreen)和米凱爾·喬杜里(Mikail Chowdhury)，而米斯菲特工作室(Misfit Studios)的傑西·懷特(Jessie White)與友善費利克斯工作室(Friendly Felix Studios)的莫辛·阿什拉夫(Mohsen Ashraf)、坦維爾·阿里(Tanveer Ali)、阿姆林·巴希爾(Amreen Bashir)及阿烏拉斯(Auras)的塔赫米德·汗(Tahmid Khan)共同擔任執行製片人。

故事設定在1948年的馬來亞，正值第二次世界大戰結束後的動盪歲月，影片講述了一名馬來士兵和一名英國士兵在英軍撤退後被遺留的故事。他們必須面對戰爭歷史，同時保護一個受到武裝叛軍威脅的村莊。

獲獎的馬來西亞演員法比安·盧(Fabian Loo)——以《雨城》(Rain Town)和《一分錢小偷》(One Cent Thief)而聞名——領銜主演，搭檔哈茲曼·阿爾-伊德魯斯(Hazman Al-Idrus)。他們的演出還有著名的印尼演員阿斯馬拉·阿比蓋爾(Asmara Abigail)（《石龜》(Stone Turtle)、《惡靈古堡》(Impetigore)）和美國演員布雷特·圖特(Brett Tutor)（《人類怪物》(Monsters of Man)）。

提瓦里表示：“我們有很多關於第二次世界大戰的電影，但很少以這個地區的人物為中心，也很少看到英軍撤退及隨之而來的混亂所帶來的影響。阿比·庫馬爾的劇本提供了探索一個令我著迷的主題的完美機會：戰爭倖存者所承受的心理創傷。”

製作團隊來自六個國家。達斯古普塔表示，拍攝反映了這個項目核心的合作雄心。“我們自豪地將來自馬來西亞、印尼、新加坡、印度、孟加拉國和英國的人才和團隊聚集在一起，讓這部電影得以實現，”她說。

這部電影還有一個顯著的特點，即它是首部完全在巴厘島拍攝的戰爭電影之一。博·霍姆格林表示：“在巴厘島拍攝讓我們能夠打造出視覺上驚人的背景，並建造了十四個場景來重現1940年代的馬來亞。將這部精彩的戰爭電影帶回其文化和歷史的根源，令人非常興奮。”

MSK Cinemas的薩拉達·西瓦林甘(Saradha Sivalingam)表示：“我們相信《夕陽子彈》(Peluru Senja)有潛力通過其獨特的身份和引人入勝的敘事與觀眾建立聯繫。我們致力於提供強有力的院線發行。”她補充道，該公司被電影的“強大敘事、真實的馬來西亞背景和強烈的情感核心，以及值得在大銀幕上體驗的高製作價值”所吸引。

懷特(White)也發表了類似的聲明。她表示：“這部電影一直以來都是在馬來西亞歷史上一個重要時刻的背景下，講述一個深刻的人性故事，我們迫不及待想要在大銀幕上與大家分享。”

該製作利用了馬來西亞的後期製作基礎設施，並融入了來自南亞和東南亞的創意聲音。

《彈幕夕陽：鬼與槍(Peluru Senja: The Ghost & the Gun)》將於8月28日在全馬來西亞的電影院上映。
